ambient_events: The lift arrives empty, opens, waits, and shuts again.
The pay station prints a receipt for nobody.
description: A concrete room the width of the building, painted the blue of the sign as far as the paint went. A pay station by the lift says PARKING FREE, with a phone number for lost tickets taped under it. The lift is in and the street is south.
name: Stacked Deck, Lobby
